dependency_conditions.reason: A valid National Identity Card is required to renew a driving licence. If your NIC is lost, complete the duplicate NIC process first.

steps.title: Check your driving licence expiry date
steps.description: Confirm the expiry date so you renew within the permitted window and avoid penalties.

steps.title: Obtain a medical fitness certificate
steps.description: Get a medical certificate of fitness to drive from the National Transport Medical Institute (NTMI) or an authorised medical officer.

steps.title: Prepare your NIC
steps.description: Bring your valid National Identity Card for identity verification.

steps.title: Fill the renewal application form
steps.description: Complete the driving licence renewal application with current details.

steps.title: Visit the RMV / authorised centre and pay the fee
steps.description: Submit your application with the medical certificate and NIC at the Department of Motor Traffic or an authorised centre, and pay the renewal fee.

steps.title: Track your renewal status
steps.description: Track issuance and collect the renewed driving licence.
